COMPRESS-355.label: I
COMPRESS-355.reason: Same TAR/PAX parsing area in `TarArchiveInputStream`, so it has strong regional context. However, the mechanism differs: COMPRESS-355 is about malformed PAX header length parsing causing `NegativeArraySizeException`, while the current bug is about PAX header entries whose name ends with `/` being misclassified as directories and preventing stream advancement. Shared subsystem, different failure mode.

COMPRESS-351.label: I
COMPRESS-351.reason: This is about ZIP archive truncation and error-message bloat in `ZipArchiveInputStream`/ZIP handling. It shares only the broad archive domain, not the TAR/PAX parsing path or the directory/name handling logic relevant here.

COMPRESS-344.label: I
COMPRESS-344.reason: This is archive-stream parsing in Commons Compress, but in the AR subsystem, not TAR. It does share a mechanism-level theme of handling special-case extended names/metadata terminators in archive headers, which may offer some heuristic value, but it is structurally distant from the current PAX-header trailing-slash issue.
